goal: BENCHMARK, design only. Judged against 'reference' (a pipeline published by Comfy-Org or the model vendor): the agent's stages must reach the same result with free models - the same kind of steps in the same order, each fed by the right earlier output, prompts that describe exactly what was asked, and a design that holds with every ? answered. Nothing is installed or run.

reference.source: Comfy-Org template templates-6-key-frames (official, free: Wan 2.2 14B FLF2V x5, batched)
steps: each consecutive pair of the six images -> a first-last-frame clip (5 clips)
clips joined in order into one video
must: five first-last-frame segments between consecutive user images
each image is the end of one segment and the start of the next

turns.text: I'll upload six images that are the key moments of a story - a seed, a sprout, a sapling, a young tree, a big tree, then the tree in autumn. Turn them into one continuous video that morphs smoothly from each image to the next.
